overall: Confirmed checkpoint persistence and richer saved-battle context connected to existing production UI. Original persistence/admission/settlement paths and save15/7RNG retained. Engine,GUI and21fresh-process restores PASS;physical mobile approval remains separate.

implementation.confirmation: New presentation-only battle_save_notice reads only a matching validated RunStore.pending after successful original _persist_battle. A newly durable checkpoint gives3simulation-seconds on the existing mission button. No new input area,per-frame file IO,timer node or gameplay state. Initial save/same checkpoint/settings save/restore normalization cannot repeat or fabricate a checkpoint toast.
implementation.failure: On failed writing,retain the last actually durable checkpoint,hide success text/context and preserve existing pause/retry recovery. Actual retry can confirm the new checkpoint once. Never infer successful writing from simulation.checkpoint_index or elapsed.
implementation.saved_context: Existing lobby Continue label now shows actual stored mode/map/stage/time/checkpoint/level/HP/MP/earned gold;pending choices and free dungeon Continue are explicit. Paused/mission context uses the same confirmed snapshot,not later live HP. No invented maximum resources,timestamps or preview RunState. Move existing paused Continue to the top.
implementation.lifecycle: Seed stored checkpoint without toast on load/explicit restore;new run resets presentation. Notification clock freezes with original simulation,does not replay old checkpoints. Terminal result is not a resumable card. Existing explicit Continue,choices,error menus and tickets/revisions remain authoritative.
implementation.ownership: One RunState/save15/7RNG.66protected production/data/asset files byte-identical to base. main.gd only changes the saved-summary label and adds a virtual text formatter;original persist/ensure/retry/restore/park methods unchanged. No economy,HP,XP,spawns,audio,art or dependencies changed.
implementation.qa_teardown: Unchanged magic suite briefly exited before asynchronous WAV playback cleanup. Added250ms post-host teardown wait only;all3425native rerun. One temporary v15campaign harness still warned at250ms;1second post-host drain rerun retained exact state PASS and no leak warnings. No gameplay delay added.

growth_data_contract.scope: JSON schema/content and source integration markers only; not GDScript runtime/behavior.

magic_data_contract.scope: JSON validation, negative data controls and source markers/arithmetic; NOT GDScript runtime, UI, input dispatch or mobile tests.

feedback_source_contract.scope: 7 affected code/test/checker files: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, Python syntax, reaction constants, integration markers, engine-test registration and new dependency paths only. NOT the full project check or GDScript parser/type/runtime, rendering, or mobile input tests.

mobile_hud_source_contract.scope: Changed UTF-8 files, delimiters, Python syntax and integration source checks only. NOT GDScript parsing/typechecking, actual Control geometry, touch dispatch, rendering or mobile execution.

run_navigation_source_contract.scope: UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax and navigation SOURCE contracts only; NOT GDScript parsing/types, native execution, actual UI/input, or mobile testing.

combat_cues_source_contract.scope: Changed-source UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax, hook order, bounds, isolation, reviewed GAME-024 RunState/GAME-028 view baselines and preserved engine runner. NOT Godot parser/type/runtime, visual quality, input dispatch, or FPS.
